tools.name: search_fields
tools.description: Find rentable fields near a location. With a date, returns only fields with open slots that day (at start_time if given), each with a booking_url.

tools.name: get_field
tools.description: Details for one field: address, surface, size, hourly prices, opening hours and operator.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Open start times with prices for one field over up to 14 days, each with a booking_url.
